Required. Naming convention template for private endpoint NIC resources (supports RESOURCE/SUBRESOURCE/VNETID placeholders).

Optional. Shared app/storage public-access mode. Auto preserves legacy private-endpoint/IP inference. Monitoring access remains separately configured.
